_README: Data for the two trust pages of the Bir × Barot dossier. Everything here must be REAL: real photos from real trips, real words from real people (with their permission), real creators who actually travelled. Empty lists are fine — the pages print a clearly marked slot for each missing item and the PDF filename gets a -DRAFT suffix, so an unfinished dossier can't be sent by accident. Photos go in bir-dossier-assets/.

reviews.quote: I almost didn’t book because I was going alone, and honestly, that was the best part. By the first night, I already knew everyone’s names and somehow felt like I’d come with a group of friends. The itinerary was insane, but it never felt rushed. Yacht party, beach days, random late-night plans… it genuinely felt like one of those trips you wish you could do again for the first time.
reviews.name: Rhea, 24

reviews.quote: Plot Twist doesn’t feel like a travel company. It feels like someone took all the best parts of a trip with your closest friends and somehow planned the whole thing for you. Every day had a completely different vibe, and there was always something happening. I’ve done Goa so many times, but this felt like a completely different Goa.
reviews.name: Aanya, 26

reviews.quote: I went in expecting a fun weekend. I didn’t expect to come back with a camera roll full of memories and a group chat that’s still active weeks later. 😂 The people honestly made the trip. Everyone came from different places, but somehow the vibe just clicked. If you’re waiting for your friends to be free before travelling, just stop waiting and book the trip.
reviews.name: Simran, 25
